info.description: All implemented API routes. Import the matching environment and read docs/postman-testing.md. Send mutations individually. Run the Role access checks folder after logging in all three roles. Saved examples are illustrative. Updated: login/refresh saves tokens to both collection and active environment. Checkout explicitly uses customerToken. Login as CUSTOMER before checkout.

request.description: Assigned Courier or Admin for operational transitions; Customer can cancel own CREATED shipment. CREATED→PICKED_UP→IN_TRANSIT→OUT_FOR_DELIVERY→DELIVERED/FAILED; Admin FAILED→IN_TRANSIT/RETURNED. Expected status required. Pickup/dispatch/delivery require verified PAID and active courier; DELIVERED/FAILED/RETURNED require note. Returns data.shipment; conflicts 409.
